port.name: Kobe Rokko Island
port.name_ja: 神戸六甲アイランド港

arrival_terminal.address: 1-1, 3-chome Koyocho Higashi, Higashinada-ku, Kobe City, Hyogo Prefecture, 658-0031

access.guidance: Take the Rokko Liner from either JR Sumiyoshi Station or Hanshin Uozaki Station. Get off at "Island Kitaguchi" Station. A shuttle bus (ferry bus) for the Rokko Island Ferry Terminal departs from this station. The Rokko Liner operates every 4 to 5 minutes (every 10 minutes after 9pm). "Island Kitaguchi" station is 6 minutes from JR Sumiyoshi Station…

From Osaka When travelling on the Hanshin Expressway from Osaka, exit at the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Line, Uozaki Ramp, and turn left at the third signal (the Hakutsuru Sake bulletin board). From there, move to the Rokko Liner Island Kitaguchi Sta. bus stop (8 minutes on foot) and get on the shuttle bus. Approx. 10-minute walk from JR Nishi Oita Station Approx. 15 minutes by bus (Oita Kotsu) from JR Oita Station. Get off at the "Oji Minato-machi" bus stop. A bus to Oita Station is available only when disembarking from the Sunflower at Oita Port.
The easiest approach is to take Route 10 from the Oita Expressway, Oita IC.

From Oita Airport Take the express bus bound for Oita Station (via Beppu Kitahama) (Airport Express Airliner) and get off at "Oita Station". Route Please click here for timetable. Travel time is approximately 65 minutes and the cost of a ticket is JPY1550. Change a bus at JR Oita station. Get off at "Oji Port Town" bus stop.
